crossrefs.text: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.
Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past
You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abrahamʼs seed and heirs according to the promise.
And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ
In Him we were also chosen as Godʼs own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,
and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,
and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.
He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.
To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
In Him we were also chosen as Godʼs own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,
Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
being fully persuaded that God was able to do what He had promised.
“Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is anything too difficult for Me?
Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”
and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,
“Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!
Therefore He is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.
